newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks show no marked moves in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks show no marked moves in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks hovered in early Thursday morning trade with no marked movement in either direction after the key index fell briefly through the 20,000 barrier the previous day, brokers said.

They said there were few fresh factors to inspire trade, draining the market of participants. After 24 minutes of trade, the Nikkei average was up 5.90 points or 0.03 percent at 20,202.32. Its September futures however were flat at 20,220.
"There was quite a lot of selling on Wednesday and as the U.S. markets were firm overnight the market should be ready for a rebound," one broker said.
